rss_diagnostic.design: Register and freeze a new diagnostic before running it. Use an external sampler recording per-PID start time, command role, RSS and PSS where available. Separate corpus/tokenizer/provenance/model-hash phases and product initialization/ingestion/query/finalization. Keep original inclusive phase views alongside disaggregated values. Match sources/data/seed and balanced order, preserve every sample and all failures; absence of PSS is explicit. No retrospective rewrite of old measurements.
rss_diagnostic.runtime_claim: Do not claim a product leak or a product memory reduction without direct evidence; no demonstrated runtime leak exists at registration.
